sourceLimits: Kinneer transport resistance/restoration is abstract-only, and Tomabechi direct transport uses modified human SLC46A3 expressed in canine kidney cells, alongside separate breast-cancer cell experiments.
Ogitani supports local chemical delivery in named mixed models, not distant immune memory or clinical benefit.
MIRD publisher targeted paragraphs substitute for failed XML; equations and tables were not read as usable formulae.
Current Giffin abstract supports HLE and model exposure, but fresh Fc-architecture detail remains unavailable. The root note retains earlier source scope.
The initial DailyMed requests returned HTML shells despite HTTP 200. Corrected /dailymed/services paths yielded the raw SPLs; the bad responses are not readings.
The NCI shortcut that target-negative cells will not be harmed is not adopted.
NRC alpha/beta definitions do not constitute a clinical comparison.
Crossref queried updates are not an exhaustive correction/retraction certification.
Elicit: No callable Elicit tool; no discovery questions or report links invented.
